result.summary: The page appears mostly well-designed, but there is a minor layout issue with the category filter pills where the last visible pill ('Healthy') is partially cut off, suggesting the horizontal scroll container isn't properly configured to show complete items.

issues.description: The 'Healthy' category filter pill on the right edge is partially cut off, indicating the horizontal scroll container doesn't have proper padding or snap settings to ensure full visibility of items.
issues.suggestion: Add right padding to the scroll container equal to the screen edge margin, or implement scroll-snap behavior to ensure pills are fully visible when scrolled.
